description: Kotlin Multiplatform layout. Production is src/commonMain and src/androidMain; there is no src/main anywhere. Under the old trigger (**/src/main/**) arch-reviewer and refactor-advisor matched nothing and were reported as skipped — a whole-codebase architecture review that never looked at the architecture, indistinguishable in the report from a clean one. boulder-friend had to work around this in pipeline.json. Routing is path-only, so the files are created empty.
